finalVerification.advice: at least one check fails at the base commit too, with this patch not applied, and every test it fails also failed there (or its output is the same), so it is reported as inherited rather than as a regression. A common cause is a project that builds on install: dependencies are installed with --ignore-scripts, because install scripts run whatever the registry serves, so a `prepare` step that generates what the tests import does not run.
